title: sendToUi
description: Posts a structured RPC/stream message from the Figma sandbox to the plugin UI iframe (action + params + optional requestId).

params.name: action
params.description: Event or action name consumed by the UI bridge (e.g. 'selectionchange', 'pdf-progress').

params.name: requestId
params.description: When set, the UI treats the message as a response to a pending figma.send Promise.
